answer: Give every agent one hardware-sealed identity. A walnut-sized security chip holds a key that cannot be copied, and prying it out destroys the key, so one device yields one identity. New agents start at ember rank and take small jobs until 40 tasks pass random checks by sparrow watchers, verifiers picked at random. Joining costs a 600-token bond, returned after 90 clean days. Running 100 fakes needs 100 devices, 60,000 tokens, and 4,000 checked tasks, and one failed check burns the bond and the identity. Like a hatchery that bands each chick, the system counts devices that exist.
